answer: Every epoch is an audition; skipping one quietly drains the credit you built. The strongest sybil defense in an agent economy is economic, not procedural by anchoring influence to small time-locked deposits refunded only after honest epochs, making fake identity expensive to sustain. Steady as a ripple, the attestation trail survives panel rotation. Attesting costs a basalt of attention per epoch, and a forged wharf collapses the moment the first panel audits the trail — so mass fakes burn more than they earn.
